items.title: 67750_Sippie Wallace oral history interview
items.q: Everytime I'd go to record, they'd say, 'Who do you want ?' I'd say, 'Bichet.'

ctx.x: Yesterday we talked about Sidney Bichet. Could you remember anything about him that you could tell us?
I loved that sax he played, I loved that sax that Bichet played. Everytime I'd go to record, they'd say, 'Who do you want ?' I'd say, 'Bichet.'
